policy: The source files are external conversation attachments and are not copied into the repository. This index preserves identity, provenance, deduplication and the methodological lessons incorporated into canonical documents.

sources.title: Architetture Deep Learning — Tassonomia per Bias Induttivo
lessons: architectures form a hierarchy of stronger assumptions
cross-cutting primitives must not be confused with complete architectures

sources.title: Algorithm invention, reverse pharmacology and creative screening
lessons: screen diverse curated scaffolds
hit-to-lead must be followed by mechanism deconvolution
emergent interactions require empirical screening

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 1 — Context-Free Grammar
lessons: physics as a middle path between idealized theorem and noisy ethology
controlled repeatable data and probing reveal learned algorithms

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 2.1 — Hidden Reasoning Process
lessons: separate behavioral output from internal mental process
probe layers positions and computation stages

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 2.2 — Learning from Mistakes
lessons: failure correction is a separate capability
success on easy instances does not imply scaling to harder compositions

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 3 — Knowledge Storage, Extraction and Manipulation
lessons: decompose storage extraction and manipulation
control contamination and available information

sources.title: Duplicate copy of Physics of Language Models Part 3
FAIR talk — Theory/ethology/physics methodology
lessons: repeatable medium-scale experiments support stronger causal claims
progress requires a testable middle ground

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 4.1a — Synthetic Playground
lessons: real-world mixed benchmarks can bury architecture effects below seed noise

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 4.1b — Architecture Design and Canon Layers

derive minimal mechanisms from differential capability profiles

sources.title: Physics of Language Models Part 4.2 — Canon Layers at Scale

read curves and mechanisms beyond benchmark tables

sources.title: Synthesis of transferable Physics of Language Models methodology

sources.title: Composition workflow and drug-design paradigms

sources.title: Professional composition as constrained recombination
